items.text: Every round gives you a target and ten words to hit it with. Spell something that isn't a word and the board says so — and it still costs you one.
So you find the one that works. And everything you didn't spend pays out — ten points a drop. Being efficient is the entire game.
And then it twists the knife. The best word you never saw: JERRIES. eighty-four points. It was right there.
It is free, it is just a webpage, and it is called Letterbind.
